critique.evidence: The economics section passes automated WCAG checks at all three viewports, has no touch-target or horizontal-overflow violations, exposes both expected controls with visible keyboard focus, and shows no element changes under reduced motion. However, an 8 is not justified because color contrast remains unverified in the actual tablet and mobile headers: axe reports serious incomplete contrast checks for 3 and 13 nodes respectively. The mobile/tablet navigation intentionally clips off-screen items, though contained scrolling prevents document overflow.
critique.fix: Measure the actual foreground/background contrast of every header label and link at tablet and mobile widths, including gradient/overlap states, and adjust colors or backgrounds until WCAG AA is conclusively verified. Also verify that the horizontally clipped navigation is discoverable and operable by touch and keyboard, with an announced current item and scroll position.
